title: Game FAQ
intro: New Player Guide: Pro tips from long term habitual Zoo 2 players.
summary_body: Although there are many different playing styles, the game mostly revolves around collecting and breeding animals and taking care of your zoo. You can also design and decorate along the way and enjoy the many special events and prizes every month. You can connect with other players and team up with them in a guild to earn rewards. There are lots of quests to complete and items to collect, but many players agree that patience is the way to play this game long term.
free_stuff_body: This game does not require players to spend real money in order to progress or enjoy it, but it is an optional track if you like to have extra perks and get things faster. Upjers makes lots of animals and currency available for free to engaged players. If you like to collect everything at its release, progress more quickly, or just want to treat yourself to a few special animals you really love, be sure to read tips on buying and spending diamonds. App users can also enable Bonus Offer Ads (optional) to earn bonuses, discounts, or timer reductions without spending money.
levelup_body: You can level up by earning XP (experience points). You receive XP from cleaning your zoo, helping your friends, breeding, completing achievements and quests, and placing new deco, enclosures, or animals. Leveling up gives rewards that often help you complete a quest. To level up faster, place lots of high XP-generating animals in your zoo. You can coin feed them blue feed to receive double XP. Activate a club fundraiser XP bonus of up to 10% depending on the club. If you play on the mobile app, watch an ad to activate a one-hour 10% XP boost as often as every 24 hours — it applies to all XP generated including helping friends, breeding, and placing new items. Since placing new items gives XP, buying items and/or completing puzzle pieces and placing them can provide more XP.
focus_intro: Some future tasks to consider working toward:
focus_tip_1: Prioritize breeding your pandas to level 10.
focus_tip_2: Immediately complete any pink hibiscus bushes from a single puzzle piece as soon as you get it. Leave it in your inventory and do not place it in your zoo until after you receive the quest to place 10 pink hibiscus bushes.
focus_tip_3: If you would like to maximize the free Zoo Academy voucher you receive at level 10, prioritize completing Madame Yu tasks every 6 hours to reach level 14 of the academy and maximize your Bronze membership before redeeming the voucher.
focus_tip_4: If you still only have one or two regions by Level 93, consider stopping trash collection (and firing garbage collectors) about 24 hours before leveling up to Level 94 to ensure you have enough trash for a timed task that gives 5 diamonds.
focus_tip_5: After Level 100, you unlock a quest requiring you to open 50 retro and 50 legendary chests starting from the time you receive the quest. You can collect free chests from the calendar and if you have enough coins during an event, collect all the event chests.
coins_body: Be sure to place and upgrade all your coin-purchasable shops right away. Players have found the shops fill fastest when the game is closed. Log in every hour or two to collect coins. The more popularity points you have, the more visitors buy from your shops. Save your coins for an event or a sale. Wait until the shops go on sale before buying or upgrading any diamond shops. Some players breed and sell high-value coin animals such as the Northern Bald Ibis or the Royal Blue Tang to gain coin profits — any coin-purchasable animal that can be bought for 100,000 coins or more is preferred. Diamond animals are not profitable to sell for coins.
diamonds_body: Diamonds are considered premium currency. Some quests require diamonds to complete. If you are patient, many of these diamond items can be found inside the game for free. You can hide these quests if needed. You can earn diamonds for free or purchase them from the store for real money.
spending_intro: Almost everything in the game goes on sale. If you are patient, you can maximize your spending budget. It is best to wait for a Cashback event to buy most things, including items that are known never to be discounted.
spending_no_sale_diamonds: Diamond items that do not go on sale: Admissions Booth Entrance Upgrades, Breeding Slots*, Keys (for chests), Prize Wheel Timer Resets, Zoo Academy Subscriptions, Season Pass Feathers. (*Note: The breeding center itself has been known to go on sale, but the locked slots inside have never been directly discounted.)
spending_no_sale_coins: Coin items that do not go on sale: Regular blue chests, Terrain Editor, Bulldozer.
spending_avoid: Purchases to avoid spending diamonds on: 3× diamond food bucket (use coins on 2× feed instead); keeping animals as babies instead of growing up (place babies in inventory to keep them from growing up).
sales_body: Zoo 2 regularly has sales on shelters/upgrades, shops/upgrades, decorations, enclosures, diamond chests, and land expansions. Sometimes shop animals in various biomes are discounted. Less frequently, there are sales on club shop items, trash cans/restrooms, and buildings/region unlocks. Sales generally range from 30–50% off.
land_body: Wait for land sales to get 33–50% off purchasing land plots. Prioritize buying coin land and plan ahead for the few diamond plots you need to connect. Only shops and enclosures have to be on a connected path. Enclosures with animals inside can be moved from a path to an unconnected land plot and still produce XP for cleaning/feeding/playing — but you won't get any popularity points for disconnected enclosures. Unlocking certain regions can give you more coin land for purchase. You can buy Oceanside Zoo for more land for any main zoo enclosure as well as water enclosures (you will need to unlock the terrain editor first to change the ground to blue tiles).
seasonal_body: Save your coins for seasonal events so that you can get all the prizes without spending diamonds. The Buy-Collect-Sell trick gives event currency in exchange for your coins.
season_pass_body: Take the daily quiz by clicking the penguin in the top left of your screen and then "Quiz." Answer 5 questions correctly to earn up to 350 Season Pass XP every day to level up on the Season Pass path and collect the rewards. If you want to do less thinking, click one answer repeatedly without reading the question and submit until you have answered 5 correctly — there is no penalty for wrong answers. Complete the weekly tasks to earn more XP. They reset every Thursday.
conservation_body: Breed and release certain event-highlighted animals all week for a chance to win conservation statue decorations, profile titles, and most importantly diamonds! Complete quests to earn more points and prizes. The entire Zoo 2 community can also earn extra prizes including diamonds by collectively gaining points.
calendar_body: A login reward calendar gives daily prizes. If you want a breeding pair of the rewarded animals, check how many puzzle pieces of the animal you are getting for the month. Complete your first animal with tickets before you get your final puzzle piece so that you can complete the second animal at a Chest Sale when completing puzzles is discounted. The December calendar works slightly differently — you must manually click the door prize each day to collect the login reward.
friends_body: You can click the "jump to" shortcut button at the bottom of your helping friends screen to find the next crow, child, or animal instantly without searching the entire zoo. Use social media to find active daily helpers to earn more friendship chests, including friendship animals. All they need is your Support ID (found in settings) to add you to their friends list. App users may also watch an ad or pay a diamond to help a friend instead of playing the mini-game.
animals_body: There are hundreds of animal species inside the game. Some are needed for collections, some for contests, and some for quests. Others are event animals, premium animals, VIP animals, and chest animals that are nice to have. You can get some animals from puzzle pieces in chests, the calendar, an event, or the prize wheel for free. Others you can buy from a flash sale or the ice cream man. Most animals will come to the game for free if you have enough patience — bonus animals offered with a real money diamond purchase generally take up to three years to enter a free obtainability cycle.
free_mate_body: When buying or otherwise obtaining animals from the Animal Shop, a few come with a free mate as a quest reward after placing the first animal. Known list (may not be exhaustive): Okapi, Common Ostrich, Reticulated Giraffe, American Bison, Plains Zebra, Goldfish (Aquarium), Emperor Scorpion (Terrarium), Reef Manta Ray (Oceanside).
breeding_body: You can breed animals by placing a male and a female in an enclosure with the required upgraded shelter and an available breeding slot. Two level 1 animals make a level 2 baby. Once placed in an enclosure, the baby takes one week to grow up. You can change the gender of an animal by clicking it and selecting the gender icon. You can breed the same species in multiple enclosures at the same time in any region. There is a very rare chance of skipping levels by breeding a sparkling animal. To level up animals more quickly, prep them for twin/triplet breeding events by building up the breeding success probability to around 20% and then stopping. To increase breeding success, join a club with an active breeding bonus (up to 10%), coin feed inside the breeding center, and move animals to their corresponding region for applicable biome bonuses.
oceanside_body: You can breed all biomes in Oceanside Zoo! Use the terrain editor to change the ground to blue tiles in order to place grassland, plains, forest, mountain, savanna, ice, and jungle enclosures in Oceanside. You can breed all biomes in this region, not just water.
petting_body: Some tasks require you to pet an animal. Click or press on the animal and hold until the camera zooms in and little hearts float up from the animal. Tips: Turn on "Reduced Animations" in Settings so your animals do not move. If the task does not specify which animal to pet, pick a larger animal. Zoom in so the animals are larger and you have a bigger target to click on.
enclosure_resize_body: You can change the size and shape of any enclosure for space purposes or to turn it into a decoration. Some players even cut out holes in the center for more decorating area or reshape enclosures to spell words.
clubs_body: There are many active clubs searching for members. Although you can create your own guild for 10 diamonds, it is best to use social media to connect with other clubs first to get the most benefit and understand how it works. Only the top 300–400 clubs get a decent amount of puzzle piece prizes every week. Some basic club tips: breed all contest animals to level 20 and prioritize your diamonds to open more breeding slots when possible. Aiming for top 75 will get your club 50 statue puzzle pieces. Aiming for top 300 will get your club 50 variant puzzle pieces. If your club is unlikely to win top 100, it is best to donate a single animal, reap the club XP, and try again next time.
puzzles_body: If possible, wait for a Chest Sale before scrapping puzzle pieces or completing items. It is generally best practice at lower levels to complete the first diamond animal puzzle piece you get with tickets so that your second piece can be used for a second animal. App users: enabling Bonus Offer Ads provides the option of completing puzzles for a 10% discount by watching an ad. For players at level 90+, the Aviary region is a good investment for tickets — each day after the login calendar resets, 20 feathers drop from the sky and each feather has a chance to give an aviary puzzle piece.
scrap_body: When scrapping items, it is generally best practice at lower levels to scrap only coin items. Exceptions include the Mountain Gorilla (not available in the shop) and some animals that only unlock at very high levels, such as the African Buffalo or the Argali. Try not to open a diamond chest unless you have enough keys (4) to get the guaranteed animal you need if you are short on chests.
no_scrap_intro: Items needed for quests that you should consider saving instead of scrapping:
no_scrap_decos: 1 Plains Lantern, 1 Savanna Lantern, 1 Ice Lantern, 1 Water Playground, 1 Rose Arch, 4 Pink Rose Bushes, 5 Bushes (plains), 2 Forest Lanterns, 2 Hollylocks, 1 Forest Fountain, 1 Play Wheel (Leafy Thicket), 2 Berry Bush (forest), 1 Tree Stump (forest), 10 Pink Hibiscus, 1 Trough (rocky desert), 1 Fire Coral (saltwater), 1 Signpost, 1 Plains Signpost, 1 Forest Signpost, 1 Jungle Signpost, 1 Water Signpost, 3 Ice Benches.
no_scrap_animals_intro: Quest diamond animals (not offered as level up rewards or quest rewards before level 106):
no_scrap_animals: Komodo Dragons, Aardvarks, Ocelots, African Elephants, Mandrills, Snowy Owls, Walruses, Spotted Skunks, Fishing Cats, Sea Otters, Emperor Penguins, Harpy Eagles, Jaguarundis, Irrawaddy Dolphins (prize wheel only), Giant Otter Shrew (prize wheel only), American Black Bears, Eastern Grey Kangaroos, Black-Backed Jackals (prize wheel only), 2nd Polar Bear, 2nd Green Anaconda, 2nd Scarlet Macaw, 2nd Moon Bear, 2nd Tapir, 1st Okapi.
no_scrap_wheel: Animals not tied to quests but in the prize wheel that may be needed for collections: Llama, Ribbon Seal, White-Faced Owl, Spot-Bellied Eagle-Owl, Squirrel Monkey, Indian Giant Squirrel.
tickets_body: If you are short on tickets, wait for a Chest Sale where completing an item is 15% off. You can also reset the prize wheel for 10 diamonds (recommended during a bi-monthly Cashback sale) or open many regular blue chests until you have enough scrappable material. If you are trying to complete a club statue without all puzzle pieces, consider waiting for a Chest Sale and using diamonds to complete the last few pieces — if you have 90 puzzle pieces of a statue, you can complete it with 10 diamonds immediately or wait for the sale and get it for 7 diamonds.
academy_tips_body: For premium players, the Zoo Academy gives lots of benefits including exclusive animals, shorter breeding times, more coins, and more XP. It is best to activate the academy during a Cashback sale. If you do not have an active subscription, buy 1 day Bronze for 8 diamonds to enable the renewal discount — renewing is much cheaper than restarting. Important early tip: you should receive a free Zoo Academy voucher for a 7-Day Bronze subscription once you reach level 10 of the game. In order to reap the full benefits, wait until you reach Madame Yu scroll level 14 before activating the voucher — this way you will have all 14 levels of the Bronze academy benefits for the week.
hide_quests_body: Click Grandpa in the top left corner of the screen. Select the book icon to see active and completed quests. Scroll to the incomplete quest you want to hide. Uncheck the bottom right box to hide the quest.
rocks_body: Kujali Park, a savanna-themed region that fits overflow animals of all biomes from the main zoo, contains extra land that can be unlocked for diamonds or coins. The coin land in this region requires extra coins to break rocks for special prizes — puzzle pieces for region-specific decorations, paths, coins, XP, or diamonds are all possible prizes.
steam_body: It is great that Steam or Epic Games introduced you to Zoo 2! There are some limitations to be aware of — if you intend to play this game long term and have not spent a lot of money on it yet, check the Platforms page on the Zoo 2 Wiki for advice on whether or not to continue with Steam or Epic.
